name: v1.81.0 - libtmux 0.67.1
body:
tmuxp 1.81.0 updates libtmux to 0.67.1. A `#` in a workspace's `session_name`, a `window_name` or a `start_directory` now reaches tmux as typed, so `window_name: "#S"` names the window `#S` instead of the session's name.

## Highlights

### `#` in workspace names and start directories is kept as typed

A `#` in a workspace's `session_name`, a `window_name` or a `start_directory` reaches tmux as typed, so `window_name: build#2` names the window `build#2` and `window_name: "#S"` names it `#S`. tmux used to expand these values as formats, so `#S` became the session name. A workspace file that relied on that expansion now gets the literal text.

### libtmux 0.67.1

tmuxp now requires libtmux `~=0.67.1` (was `~=0.66.0`). [libtmux 0.67.0](https://github.com/tmux-python/libtmux/releases/tag/v0.67.0) keeps names, titles, start directories and buffer paths as typed and adds `libtmux.Format` to ask tmux to expand one value; [libtmux 0.67.1](https://github.com/tmux-python/libtmux/releases/tag/v0.67.1) makes `Session.new_window(select_existing=True)` find a window by its literal name on every tmux.

## What's Changed
* libtmux 0.67.1 by @tony in https://github.com/tmux-python/tmuxp/pull/1111


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tmux-python/tmuxp/compare/v1.80.0...v1.81.0
